# PathPort (https://getpathport.com/)

> PathPort is an individual-owned encrypted credential and document storage vault, free personal ID expiration tracker, verifiable professional portfolio builder (`MyPortfolio`), and credential-matched job search and career growth platform (`MyPath Career`). Built for professionals across technology, project management, healthcare, EMS, aviation, skilled trades, education, and research—plus anyone tracking a passport or driver’s license for free.

## Core Modules & Brand Hierarchy
- **PathPort Document Vault (`/document-vault/`)**: Private AES-256 encrypted storage with SHA-256 file hashing for licenses, CE/PDU/CPE certificates, degrees, case study PDFs, and digital badges. Supports 60-second import from resumes, LinkedIn PDFs, Credly/Accredible/Badgr URLs, bulk OCR uploads, and Email-to-Vault forwarding (`@in.getpathport.com`).
- **Free Personal ID & Passport Tracker (`/free-id-tracker/`) — $0 Free Forever**: Track Driver’s Licenses, REAL IDs, Passports (including 6-month travel buffers), Global Entry / TSA PreCheck, and Vehicle Registrations with 90/60/30-day renewal alerts—plus free employee sharing for **PathPort Workplace** requests.
- **MyPortfolio (`/myportfolio/`)**: Verifiable professional portfolios (`getpathport.com/p/yourname`) built for hiring, consulting proposals, conference Speaker One-Sheets, hospital/agency credentialing, promotions, board seats, and fellowships. Includes `Modern`, `Executive`, and `Minimal` themes, QR codes, PDF dossiers, and 1-click revocation.
- **MyPath Career (`/mypath/`)**: Credential-matched job search engine, AI/rules-backed career path suggestions (with USDOL CareerOneStop licensure and BLS salary context), instant job-alignment scoring and What-If gap audits, 6-pillar professional growth tracking (`Learn`, `Credential`, `Experience`, `Build`, `Publish`, `Lead`), and Application & Interview Studio (tailored resumes, cover letters, and STAR interview prep grounded in real evidence).
- **50-State & National Board Renewal Engine (`/tools/renewal-calculator/`)**: Built-in renewal rules across all 50 US states + DC, ANCC, AACN, AANPCB, NREMT, PMI PMP, AHVAP CVAHP, ISC2 CISSP, and CompTIA Security+.
- **PathPort Workplace (`/for/enterprise/`, Launching 2027)**: Workforce credential collection and compliance tracking without email back-and-forth, plus direct CEU assignment for event attendees.
- **PathPort Certify (`/for/board-certifications/`, Launching 2027)**: End-to-end credential management for certifying bodies across applications, payments, exam sync, badge issuance, and recertification.

## Canonical Pricing & Free Trial Policy
- **Personal Identity Documents Tracker ($0 • Free Forever)**: Track everyday identity documents (Driver’s License, REAL ID, Passport, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck, Vehicle Registration) with proactive renewal alerts and free PathPort Workplace sharing.
- **PathPort Essentials ($7.99/mo billed annually, or $9.99/mo billed monthly)**: Unlimited credentials, full 8-entity Living Record, 60-second Resume/LinkedIn/Credly/bulk OCR import, Email-to-Vault forwarding (`@in.getpathport.com`), 50-state and national board renewal tracking, private SHA-256 Document Vault, and 1 shareable MyPortfolio link.
- **PathPort Pro ($14.99/mo billed annually, or $19.99/mo billed monthly)**: Everything in Essentials plus full **MyPath Career** (credential-matched job search engine, career path suggestions, instant job alignment & What-If role audits, 6-pillar growth tracking, Application & Interview Studio), custom portfolio slugs, and unlimited custom MyPortfolio links.
- **Free Pro Trial**: New accounts start with a free Pro trial with no credit card required (30 days through Nov 30, 2026; 14 days starting Dec 1, 2026). Veritas Technology Solutions, LLC never sells user data or trains public third-party AI models on private documents.
